lives: My idea lives in the -arium: a cold, orderly hall where each specimen is kept exact and still, while the margin itself is the crowded warmth I guard against.

veto.quote: mush, clutter, warmth that turns cloying
veto.why: Kept beside every choice, the vetoes, runners-up and jurors' notes would fill each decision's margin until the page is clutter.

line: Release the colors a few at a time, as snow settles, and keep the margin still.
